goal: Prevent identical relayed address announcements from artificially inflating address multiplicity
Ensure address entries are not given unwarranted presence in the new address table
agreement: Support because it reduces inflated address counts on privacy networks (stratospher)
Verified by reproducing the duplicate announcement issue in tests (frankomosh)
Objection that the check blocks genuinely newer announcements after a refresh (taki-abedesselam, fametrano)
Author agreed with the bug report and plans to address it in the next update

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes unintended multiplicity increases from identical relayed gossip
The benefit is modest because it does not stop deliberate manipulation by peers
